lcc_original: 雅列活到一百六十二歲，生了以諾。
notes: Hebrew שנה (H08141/year) appears twice in the source — once after שׁשׁים (sixty) and once after מאת (hundred). UNV renders the first as implicit and the second as 歲; LCC likewise has only one 歲, so the first WH08141 is kept as {<WH08141>} (implicit) in the same position.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: the Hebrew direct-object marker אֵת has no Chinese equivalent in LCC just as in UNV.
